levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Fewer than six recurring bill categories are listed, or a major category (housing, a utility, food) is missing entirely.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least six plausible recurring bill categories are listed with a fictional amount for each.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Categories include at least one less-obvious but real expense (such as renter's insurance or a recurring transit cost) beyond the warm-up list.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The stated leftover/shortfall does not match income minus the sum of listed bills.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The leftover/shortfall figure correctly equals income minus the sum of listed bills.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The learner shows the running arithmetic (not just a final number), making the calculation easy to check.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Figures are wildly unrealistic in relation to each other (e.g., rent listed as less than a phone bill) with no acknowledgment.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Figures are internally plausible relative to each other, even though invented.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The reflection response shows awareness of which figure was hardest to estimate plausibly and why.

lookFors: No real account numbers, real balances, or identifiable real household financial details appear anywhere.
Income minus total bills equals the stated leftover/shortfall exactly.
The reflection names a specific category, not a generic 'I forgot something.'

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
